description.value: Riley's Cidery sits in a remarkable one-of-a-kind heirloom apple orchard on Bowen Island containing nearly a thousand varieties, planted over 30 years by collectors John and Josephine Riley. Visitors can taste craft ciders made from these heritage apples and enjoy a picnic area overlooking the orchard. The cidery is run by Christine and Rob, who took over stewardship of this living museum in 2019 and trained in traditional English cidermaking.
